description: This source file defines classes related to fault injection mechanisms for Azure Table Transactional State Storage within Orleans transactional testing. It includes a wrapper class that injects faults into store operations and a factory class for creating such wrapped instances.

classes.name: FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorage
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing ITransactionalStateStorage that injects faults into store operations for testing purposes.

classes.name: FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of fault-injecting Azure Table transactional state storage, integrating with Orleans lifecycle.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Delegates the load operation to the underlying AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Wraps the store operation with fault injection hooks before and after the actual storage call.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates instances of FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorage with specified state name and context.

methods.description: Static factory method for creating an instance of FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorageFactory.

methods.description: Registers the factory with the Silo lifecycle.
